# Setup

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
  source("./Parameters.R")
  library(scales)
```
# Load: Model Fits

```{r Load_Fits}
  fits <- list.files(path = "../Processed", pattern = "^Processed.*[.]Rdata$", full.names = TRUE)
  all_results <- foreach(f = fits, .packages = "tidyverse") %dopar% {
    load(f)
    list(tmpc_total %>% mutate(period = p, climat = c, densite = d, sex = s, age = a),
         days_total %>% mutate(period = p, climat = c, densite = d, sex = s, age = a),
         parametric %>% mutate(period = p, climat = c, densite = d, sex = s, age = a),
         te_smooths %>% mutate(period = p, climat = c, densite = d, sex = s, age = a))
  }
  tmpc_total <- rbindlist(lapply(all_results, function(x){x[[1]]}))
  days_total <- rbindlist(lapply(all_results, function(x){x[[2]]}))
  parametric <- rbindlist(lapply(all_results, function(x){x[[3]]}))
  te_smooths <- rbindlist(lapply(all_results, function(x){x[[4]]}))
  print(sprintf("Total number of models fitted: %7d", length(fits)))
  print(sprintf("Total number of summer deaths: %7d", sum(days_total$n)))
```
# Check: Model Quality

The mean absolute difference (MAD) between the predicted and the observed number of summer death is computed by year, climate, urbanization, sex, age group, and mean temperature (current day, lag = 0 days, rounded to 1°C). For each temperature, and by sex age group, the plot shows the mean MAD across all analysis years, climates, and urbanizations (line) as well as the minimum and maximum (ribbon edges), for each of the four models.

```{r MAD}
  tmpc_mad <- tmpc_total %>% mutate(tmpc_lag_0 = round(tmpc_lag_0, 0)) %>%
    group_by(year, climat, densite, sex, age, tmpc_lag_0) %>% reframe(across(matches("(PO|GA)$"), ~mean(abs(.x - n)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), names_to = "Model") %>%
    mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA"))) %>%
    mutate(age = factor(age, levels = rev(AGE_BRACKETS$age))) %>%
    group_by(sex, age, tmpc_lag_0, Model) %>% reframe(ymean = mean(value), ymin = min(value), ymax = max(value))
  plot_pdf_png("Figure_2", aspect_ratio = 1.4,
    tmpc_mad %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = tmpc_lag_0, y = ymean, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, color = Model, fill = Model)) +
      geom_line() + geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.1, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
      labs(x = "Mean Temperature [°C] (Lag=0, Buckets=1°C)", y = "Mean Absolute Difference (MAD) between Predicted and Observed Number of Summer Deaths (by Year, Climate, Urbanization)") +
      std_theme() + theme(legend.position = "top") + facet_grid(vars(age), vars(sex), scales = "free_y"))
```
# Check: Fit Quality

```{r QQ}
  # QQ plot for mortality rate residuals, by year, day of year, climat, densite, sex and age group
  plot_pdf_png("Figure_3", aspect_ratio = 1.4,
    days_total %>%
      mutate(across(c(DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), ~100000.0 * (n - .x) / pop)) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), names_to = "Model", values_to = "Rate_Residuals") %>%
      mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA"))) %>%
      mutate(age = factor(age, levels = rev(AGE_BRACKETS$age))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(sample = Rate_Residuals, group = Model, color = Model)) +
      stat_qq(size = 0.01) + stat_qq_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = -2:2) +
      labs(x = "Theoretical Quantiles (Normal Distribution, Standard Deviations)", y = "Sample Residuals: Daily Mortality Rate [1/100k] (by Year, Day of Year, Climate, Urbanization)") +
      std_theme() + theme(legend.position = "top") + facet_grid(vars(age), vars(sex), scales = "free_y"))
```
# Plot: Mortality

```{r Plot}
  # aggregate fitted values to country level, by period, climat, densite, sex, age group, and by 1°C buckets
  total_rates <- tmpc_total %>% filter(tmpc_lag_0 >= 9.0, tmpc_lag_0 <= 31.0) %>% mutate(t = 2.0 * round(tmpc_lag_0 * 0.5, 0)) %>%
    group_by(period, climat, densite, sex, age, t) %>% reframe(across(c(n, DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), ~100000.0 * sum(.x) / sum(pop)), tmpc_lag_0 = sum(tmpc_lag_0 * pop) / sum(pop)) %>%
    mutate(text = ifelse(period == "1998-2004" & t == 10.0, age, "")) %>%
    select(period, climat, densite, sex, age, tmpc_lag_0, text, DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA) %>% pivot_longer(c(DLNM_PO, DE03_PO, DE03_GA, WE03_GA), names_to = "Model") %>%
    mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA")), text = ifelse(Model == "WE03_GA", text, "")) %>%
    mutate(climat = factor(climat, levels = c("Océanique", "Océanique altéré", "Semi-continental", "Montagnard", "Méditerranéen"))) %>%
    mutate(densite = factor(densite, levels = c("Urbain dense", "Urbain intermédiaire", "Rural")), age = factor(age, levels = rev(AGE_BRACKETS$age))) %>%
    mutate(period = fct_rev(period)) %>%
    group_by(period, climat, densite, sex, age, tmpc_lag_0, text) %>% mutate(ymin = min(value), ymax = max(value)) %>% ungroup()

  # plot fitted mortality rates, all models, by period, climat, densite, sex, and age group
  for (s in unique(total_rates$sex)) {
    plot_pdf_png(paste("Figure_1_40_99", s, sep = "_"), aspect_ratio = 1.4,
      total_rates %>% filter(sex == s, age %in% c("40-59", "60-79", "80-89", "90+"), Model == "WE03_GA") %>% filter(value > 0, ymin > 0, ymax > 0) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = tmpc_lag_0, y = value, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = interaction(period, age), color = period, fill = period)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) + geom_ribbon(color = NA, linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.1) +
          geom_text(aes(x = 9.0, y = value, label = text), size = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, angle = 90.0, color = "grey50") +
          scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 35, 5), limits = c(8, NA)) +
          scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 100.0, 200.0, 400.0), labels = ~sprintf("%.1f", .x)) +
          scale_color_manual(values = safe_colorblind_palette[c(10, 4, 8, 2, 5)]) +
          scale_fill_manual (values = safe_colorblind_palette[c(10, 4, 8, 2, 5)]) +
          labs(x = "Mean Temperature [°C] (Lag=0, Buckets=2°C, Range=9..31°C)", y = sprintf("Daily Mortality Rate [1/100,000]: %s (40-99)", s), color = "Period", fill = "Period") +
          std_theme() + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing = unit(0, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
          facet_grid(vars(densite), vars(climat), scales = "free_y"))
    plot_pdf_png(paste("Figure_1_00_39", s, sep = "_"), aspect_ratio = 1.4,
      total_rates %>% filter(sex == s, !age %in% c("40-59", "60-79", "80-89", "90+"), Model == "WE03_GA", period %in% c("1998-2004", "2019-2025")) %>% filter(value > 0, ymin > 0, ymax > 0) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = tmpc_lag_0, y = value, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = interaction(period, age), color = period, fill = period)) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) + geom_ribbon(color = NA, linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.1) +
          geom_text(aes(x = 9.0, y = value, label = text), size = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, angle = 90.0, color = "grey50") +
          scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 35, 5), limits = c(8, NA)) +
          scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 10.0, 20.0, 40.0, 100.0, 200.0, 400.0), labels = ~sprintf("%.2f", .x)) +
          scale_color_manual(values = safe_colorblind_palette[c(10, 2)]) +
          scale_fill_manual (values = safe_colorblind_palette[c(10, 2)]) +
          labs(x = "Mean Temperature [°C] (Lag=0, Buckets=2°C, Range=9..31°C)", y = sprintf("Daily Mortality Rate [1/100,000]: %s (00-39)", s), color = "Period", fill = "Period") +
          std_theme() + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing = unit(0, "cm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
          facet_grid(vars(densite), vars(climat), scales = "free_y"))
  }
  parametric %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA"))) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    group_by(term, sex, age, model) %>% reframe(prop_sig = 100.0 * sum(p.value < 0.05) / n()) %>% mutate(prop_sig = ifelse(prop_sig > 50, sprintf("%.01f", prop_sig), "")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = prop_sig) %>%
    select(Sex = sex, Age = age, matches("_"), Term = term) %>%
    flextable() %>% set_caption("Significance of parametric terms (proportion with p.value < 0.05, if > 50.0%)") %>% autofit() %>% align(align = "center", part = "all") %>% hline(6)
  te_smooths %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA"))) %>% filter(term == "te(hump_lag_a,tmpc_lag_a)", model != "DLNM_PO") %>%
    group_by(term, sex, age, model) %>% reframe(prop_sig = 100.0 * sum(p.value < 0.05) / n()) %>% mutate(prop_sig = ifelse(prop_sig > 50, sprintf("%.01f", prop_sig), "")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = prop_sig) %>%
    select(Sex = sex, Age = age, matches("_")) %>%
    flextable() %>% set_caption("Significance of te(tmpc_lag_a,hump_lag_a) (proportion with p.value < 0.05, if > 50.0%)") %>% autofit() %>% align(align = "center", part = "all") %>% hline(6)
  te_smooths %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("DLNM_PO", "DE03_PO", "DE03_GA", "WE03_GA"))) %>% filter(term == "ti(yday)", model != "DLNM_PO") %>%
    group_by(term, sex, age, model) %>% reframe(prop_sig = 100.0 * sum(p.value < 0.05) / n()) %>% mutate(prop_sig = ifelse(prop_sig > 50, sprintf("%.01f", prop_sig), "")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = prop_sig) %>%
    select(Sex = sex, Age = age, matches("_")) %>%
    flextable() %>% set_caption("Significance of ti(yday) (proportion with p.value < 0.05, if > 50.0%)") %>% autofit() %>% align(align = "center", part = "all") %>% hline(6)
```
